answer: Call it rate-limited nullifier. Each vote mints a nullifier from the stake. A garden registry stores spent nullifiers per epoch, so the second use is provably the second use. The reveal is one-way, so the voter stays anonymous while the ocean penalty lands on the stake. A wander tally counts reveals per funder, and a third reveal freezes every identity that funder sponsored. The attacker pays: 4912 identities cost 2654 paid peers, 85161 tokens of stake and 53147 dollars. Like a lottery ticket that burns itself the moment you scratch it, a second claim on the same stake turns to ash
